title: /create-a-space matches the Claude Design prototype end to end

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: do as many passes as you need to make the page exactly like the prototype

detail: What remains after the hero (LIVE-1765). Pass B shipped the four-move builder with the progress meter and the draft kept in the visitor's browser; the handle availability check comes with save and claim. Still open: save and claim (magic link and Google) with the saved and live states; the sections below (Sound familiar, Day one tools, Free to operate, Questions, Closing); funnel links repointed to ?kit=; the footer link. docs/design-systems/create-a-space/baseline.json lists every prototype sentence not yet in the repo; each pass removes the ids it closes, and the row closes when the baseline is empty. Side-by-side renders at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 every pass. Pass C (save and claim) shipped: the handle check beside the handle (It's free, Taken) over GET /api/check-space-handle, which answers free, taken or invalid and nothing else, with the same slug rule createSpace applies; the fifth move with the email link and Google through the existing sign-in actions, a Saved card and a Launch button in the meter; and the carry into the Vera launch hold (name, goals as intents, handle, kit, accent and host under answers.spotlight, lib/launch/carry.ts), so the launch page prefills from it, the claimed handle is the first one tried and the kit dresses the new Space. Signed-in visitors skip the account step. Left open on purpose: the prototype's Live state (the Space is made on the launch page when the Spotlight is published, so this page cannot honestly say live), and /spaces/new is not repointed (it carries pricing hints the launch does not read and the launch is dark).

verify.note: Fails while any design sentence is missing from the page.
